about: Hello! My name is José Henrique, and I’m an independent game designer based in São Paulo, Brazil. I’m also Amanda Sparks, a drag queen and cosplayer who creates games inspired by my drag persona!

With a background in Industrial Design and Game Production from Senac, I develop games under the Amand.APPs label. My projects include Shade Forest, a platformer starring a drag queen exploring a dangerous forest, and Spikes on High Heels, a volleyball game that competed in the Diversity category at BIG Festival 2019.

I started doing drag in 2011, becoming part of Brazil’s new generation of drag queens that emerged after RuPaul’s Drag Race. After years of performing and DJing in São Paulo, I decided to bring my two passions together: game design and drag.

In 2014, I created Shade Forest, a game entirely developed by me, from programming and artwork to animation and publishing. The project led to the creation of Amand.APPs, my indie game label, where I continue to combine gaming, creativity, and drag culture.
As both a game designer and a lifelong gamer, I have a critical eye for every game I play. Art, level design, game feel, storytelling, and performance — nothing escapes my evaluation!
